in_sanskrit.name: नारद
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has wisdom, knowledge, and the ability to roam freely in the forest.

in_hindi.name: नारद
in_hindi.long_meaning: नर: Man, द: To go, move, roam. A man who moves around or roams in forests.

in_tamil.name: நாரத்
in_tamil.meaning: நான் அரத்: I move around, I roam
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who moves around, roams or travels extensively.

in_telugu.name: నారద్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who roams or travels extensively.

in_marathi.name: Narad
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Man of the people
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Narada is a sage and celestial musician mentioned in Hindu mythology. He travels between the gods and humans, acting as a messenger and narrator of tales.

in_bengali.name: Narad
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Man of the people
in_bengali.long_meaning: Narad একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Narada is a sage and celestial musician mentioned in Hindu mythology. He travels between the gods and humans, acting as a messenger and narrator of tales.
